reason: I've paid for a reporting tool before that took weeks to set up and then nobody opened it, so I'm not signing up for another monthly thing off a landing page. If I'm honest I might book the free call when month end is hurting, but I wouldn't be paying £99 a month in the first month.
objection: It's another report I have to read and act on, and I don't believe a stranger will understand our agreements well enough to tell me what's billable without me spending my evenings arguing with their list.
would_change_my_mind: If the free audit came back with real, specific items, with the ticket or clause attached, that I could invoice that month and it actually cut the time my month-end invoicing takes, I'd pay the £99.
